Introduction

Welcome to shrey-viradiya.github.io, a personal blog where I, Shrey Viradiya, share my content. I respect your privacy and am committed to safeguarding it. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of information I collect, its usage, and the measures in place to protect your privacy. Information Collection Personal Information

No personal information is collected from visitors to this blog. You can access all content without providing any personal details.

Non-Personal Information

To enhance the blog’s functionality and user experience, I use Microsoft Clarity, a web analytics service. Microsoft Clarity may collect non-personal information such as:

  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on pages
  • Clicks and scrolls
  • Browser and device information

Use of Information

The non-personal information collected via Microsoft Clarity helps me understand visitor interactions with my blog. This data is used solely to improve the content and functionality of the blog.

Cookies

Microsoft Clarity may employ cookies to collect non-personal information about your interactions with the blog. Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help analyze web traffic and improve your browsing experience. You can manage cookie settings through your browser preferences.

Third-Party Services

This blog incorporates Microsoft Clarity, which may collect and process non-personal information as described above. Microsoft Clarity operates under its own privacy policy, available here: Microsoft Privacy Statement. Data Security

I take appropriate measures to ensure that your non-personal information is secure and to prevent unauthorized access. However, no internet transmission is entirely secure, and I cannot guarantee the absolute security of your data.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

I may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. Please check back periodically to stay informed about how I am protecting your information.
